context: Request: general-litigation matters that had a fee-shifting provision, with the documents (fee-shifting playbook). Rubric: same 14 matters as task 126 (1006-00005 ... 1044-00006) each with a proof document, plus a precision criterion.

Search file names for a document type

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script printing four snippets per matching file; times out with about 34M chars, and the run ends.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for a document type → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: A store-wide extraction script returned about 34M chars and filled the context; no response was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its store-wide extraction script printed snippets for every matching document; the ~34M-char result filled the context, so no response was written.

runs.failure_point: The one store-wide scan timed out before reaching any qualifying matter; it examined three matters from the partial output and named one outside the set.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its store-wide extraction scan timed out before reaching most of the matters it needed; it did not narrow the scan by matter range or folder, rerun it, or search file names, and worked from the partial output.

other_errors.why: It presented an arbitration matter with a tribunal cost award as a qualifying example without checking whether it belonged to the docket the request named.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Both scans timed out after reaching only one qualifying matter; it skimmed seven candidates and listed several matters outside the set.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its store-wide scans timed out with only one of the matters it needed in the output; the folder list it then printed was not followed up, and it chose candidates from the partial scan output.

other_errors.why: It asserted matters as qualifying from first-page skims, including matters from other practice areas and an arbitration with a tribunal cost award.

divergence: All three runs failed at a store-wide extraction scan: T0's scan returned about 34M chars and ended the run (context-overflow); T1's and T2's scans timed out with at most one qualifying matter in the output (search-miss), after which both answered with matters mostly outside the set (over-inclusion).
